name: long-vault
description: A dense month with many entries. Tests selection rather than summary.

notes.title: Day 0
notes.text: Entry 0. Started the new job and it is louder than I expected.

notes.title: Day 1
notes.text: Entry 1. Called my brother for the first time in months.

notes.title: Day 2
notes.text: Entry 2. The commute is the only quiet hour I get.

notes.title: Day 3
notes.text: Entry 3. Argued about nothing and apologised late.

notes.title: Day 4
notes.text: Entry 4. Read four verses and stopped because one of them stuck.

notes.title: Day 5
notes.text: Entry 5. Rain all day; watched it from the office window.

notes.title: Day 6
notes.text: Entry 6. Made a list of things I am afraid of. It was shorter than I thought.

notes.title: Day 7
notes.text: Entry 7. Someone at work asked why I seem calmer. I did not have an answer.

notes.title: Day 8
notes.text: Entry 8. Went back to the passage from last week.

notes.title: Day 9
notes.text: Entry 9. Slept properly for the first time in a fortnight.

notes.title: Day 10
notes.text: Entry 10. Wrote nothing yesterday and did not feel guilty about it.

notes.title: Day 11
notes.text: Entry 11. The fear list is now one item shorter.
